stories.title: Closing arguments begin in Ashley Elkins murder trial
stories.summary: Charges of murder and related offenses in the death of Ashley Elkins are headed to the jury for deliberations.

stories.title: Dearborn Heights police search for attempted arson suspect
stories.summary: Dearborn Heights police are looking for a man who they say allegedly tried to set a building on fire around midnight on Saturday.

stories.title: Watch Live: Trump pardoning 2 turkeys, Freedom and Feathers
stories.summary: Freedom and Feathers were introduced on Monday at the Willard InterContinental in Washington, where the two have been staying in a suite leading up to their trip to the White House.

stories.title: Trump takes credit for Huang's return as Nvidia CEO
stories.summary: President Donald Trump is now taking credit for Jensen Huang's return as CEO of Nvidia.

stories.title: Iran War Updates: Iran developing chemical weapons, Israeli defense minister says
stories.summary: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz said Iran was developing chemical weapons and left open the possibility of preemptive strikes if necessary.

stories.title: Maps show Iowa lead dust plume drifting southwest into Missouri Wednesday after detonation, Army shares
stories.summary: Maps of the planned lead azide detonation in Middletown show the shaded area stretching from near Burlington toward Macon, Missouri, by noon Wednesday. The forecasts will change with the weather.

stories.title: Top Denmark court upholds law allowing eviction of "non-Western" residents from "ghettos"
stories.summary: Denmark's Supreme Court has upheld a law that lets authorities limit the number of "non-Western" residents who can live in a public housing development.

stories.title: Special Thanksgiving 2026 menu at Ford Field includes a gummy 'Bears' cocktail
stories.summary: Ford Field just announced its menu for the 2026 Detroit Lions Thanksgiving game, and it includes pie nachos, cherry BBQ turkey and a gummy "Bears" cocktail.

stories.title: Thanksgiving busiest day of year for home cooking-related fires, officials say
stories.summary: The Detroit Fire Department asks area residents to make safety precautions part of any holiday plans that include candles, turkey fryers or the cooking of hot food.

stories.title: Michigan drops plans to hire Trev Alberts as its AD despite signing deal a week ago, AP source says
stories.summary: The University of Michigan has informed Trev Alberts that he will not be its next athletic director, the Associated Press reported on Tuesday.

stories.title: Detroit man charged with unsafe storage of firearm in non-fatal shooting of 5-year-old nephew
stories.summary: A Detroit man has been charged with the unsafe storage of a handgun in the non-fatal shooting of his nephew, prosecutors say.

stories.title: Army to detonate lead azide explosives in Iowa Wednesday morning, officials say
stories.summary: A federal appeals court on Monday declined to block the Army from detonating explosives containing lead azide at a munitions plant in Iowa.
